# net.minetake.basis.mediastream

Spout2 SDK is vendored at build time (not committed). Before building the native plugin:

```powershell
cd Native~
.\build-win-x64.ps1
```

The script shallow-clones [leadedge/Spout2](https://github.com/leadedge/Spout2) into `third_party/Spout2` if missing.

License: Spout2 is BSD-2-Clause. See `third_party/Spout2` after clone.
